source_summary: Vertical ink-and-light-color Chinese landscape with misty mountain ranges, dense pine/cedar slopes, a small riverside village with willows, foreground rocks and trees, and a narrow stream at the lower left. Calligraphy, seals, border, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: distant_right_mountain_massif
motifs.description: High mist-washed mountain mass rising from the upper right, including the rounded peak, adjacent sharp summit at the far right, pale ridgelines, and soft cloud-like gaps around the slopes.
must_preserve: soft gray ink washes defining the main peak
fine contour strokes along the ridges
pale mist edges where the mountain fades into blank sky
small dark texture strokes on the upper crest
subtle ocher-green color accents

motifs.name: central_forest_mountain_slope
motifs.description: Dark wooded mountain face in the middle-right, formed by dense vertical evergreen marks and layered ink washes descending toward the village valley.
must_preserve: closely spaced vertical tree strokes
dark ink massing at the lower right slope
horizontal wash bands suggesting terrain ledges
soft mist openings along the lower edge
green-gray tonal variation within the forest

motifs.name: left_distant_ridge_and_pines
motifs.description: Layered distant hills on the left with jagged small peaks, pale ridges, and thin pine stands climbing the slopes.
must_preserve: sawtooth silhouettes of the small peaks
light ink wash recession between ridge layers
fine upright pine trunks and twiggy branches
short dark foliage dabs on the hillside
blank misty valley spaces between ridges

motifs.name: foreground_pine_grove_and_rocks
motifs.description: Large foreground grove at lower left-center with leaning trunks, branching pines, shrubs, and boulders at their base.
must_preserve: curving pale tree trunks with dark outlines
angular branching structure
clustered pine needles and foliage dabs
rounded boulder contours at the base
layered ink washes separating shrubs from rocks

motifs.name: lower_foreground_stream_cascade
motifs.description: Narrow stream and small cascade entering from the lower left, with rippling water marks, dark banks, and rounded stones beside it.
must_preserve: curved ripple strokes in the water
small cascade-like dark strokes at the left edge
rounded shoreline stones
ink-dark bank contours
open paper gaps used as water highlights

motifs.name: central_village_roofs_bridge
motifs.description: Compact riverside village cluster in the center-right, including small tiled roofs, wall lines, and the narrow bridge or walkway crossing in front of the buildings.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry with dark eaves
thin horizontal and vertical wall lines
small bridge or walkway strokes over the watercourse
pale wash around the buildings to keep them embedded in mist
tiny dark accents suggesting posts and openings

motifs.name: willow_banks_around_village
motifs.description: Slender willows and bank vegetation surrounding the village, with drooping branches on both sides of the roof cluster.
must_preserve: long downward willow fronds
thin trunk lines
light ocher-green washes in the foliage
delicate branch tips around the rooftops
soft transitions into surrounding mist

motifs.name: lower_right_riverbank_rocks_shrubs
motifs.description: Low rocky riverbank and shrubs at the lower right, stopping before the red seal, with layered mounds, small trees, and pale water margins.
must_preserve: low rounded rock mounds
short shrub and grass strokes
small upright tree marks near the bank
soft wash shadows under the rocks
blank water edge separating bank from village area

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
